messages:
maya: heads-up: eval-runner uploads to artifact-store spiking during the quantization runs. seeing 429/SlowDown from S3 and CI flakes on backfills. anyone else?

simon: saw the same this morning. runner logs show lots of multipart retries + SlowDown. sample log:```2026-03-20T10:12:45Z ERROR upload failed: SlowDown (503) multipart attempt=3 backoff=1.2s part=3/12 key=evals/quant-v2/2026/abcd1234```

jess: fwiw a lot of the large objects are metadata-heavy. metadata.schema_version=1 has full kv_cache snapshots embedded per-sample. some metadata blobs are ~1.2MB which pushes object size >5MB and increases upload time.

simon: quick mitigation: reduce upload concurrency and enable gzip for metadata payloads. example runner config change I'm testing:```yamlrunner.upload:
  concurrency: 4  # was 16
  gzip_metadata: true
  multipart:
    part_size_bytes: 5_242_880  # 5MB
    max_retries: 5
    backoff_base: 0.5
```

ops-jen: our minio gateway is also rate-limiting at the API layer. smaller part sizes + fewer parallel parts helps. also noticed lifecycle job touching intermediate parts during backfills — that can cause 4xx if part list changes mid-upload.

maya: CI is flaking with an explicit metadata size error. ci-bot posted: <https://ci.redwood.com/job/5678|job#5678> - artifact upload failed: MetadataTooLarge (max_allowed=262144).

ci-bot: Job 5678 failed: artifact upload error -> MetadataTooLarge. See logs: https://ci.redwood.com/job/5678/logs

rahul: proposal: bump schema to v2 where large kv snapshots are stored as sidecar objects under /kv/<sample_id>.meta.gz and main artifact metadata keeps only a reference key and a small trace_preview (256 chars). this reduces object metadata size and makes metadata checks faster.

jess: agree. need a migration plan: eval-harness should write v2 for new runs and have a translator service for backfills that splits v1 objects into main+sidecar (or stores sidecar and rewrites metadata). also define max_metadata_bytes in config and fail fast with a clear log message.

simon: I'll open a PR to eval-runner: gzip metadata, cap metadata bytes to 256k with a warn-only mode first, and expose UPLOAD_CONCURRENCY env var (default 4). will also add CI unit test that simulates oversized metadata and asserts uploader handles 4xx gracefully and retries/backoff.

maya: also add dashboard alerts: artifact 4xx rate > 1% (5m) and storage put latency > 2s (p95). retention/ttl policy note: during long backfills lifecycle can delete old parts; ops to coordinate.

ops-jen: will run gateway tests with smaller part sizes and validate no mid-upload deletions. I'll also add a temporary throttle rule to protect production buckets while we roll out changes.

jess: I'll draft a schema v2 doc with examples and migration steps. include sample payloads:```{
  "sample_id": "abcd1234",
  "schema_version": "2",
  "prompt_len": "512",
  "trace_preview": "first 256 chars...",
  "kv_sidecar_key": "kv/abcd1234.meta.gz",
  "quant_tag": "q8_0"
}```

maya: action items: simon PR (runner changes), jess schema doc + backfill plan, ops-jen gateway tests, rahul to prototype sidecar writer. follow-up sync tomorrow 10:30. :+1: 

simon: noted, opening PR now.

jess: leaving a TODO to add CI job that runs a synthetic heavy-upload test nightly.

rahul: I'll stub a lambda to split v1 objects for backfill and measure CPU+IO.

maya: thanks all. let's keep this thread for status updates only — create PR links / tickets as they land.
